business_summary: DIC Corporation manufactures and sells printing inks, organic pigments, and synthetic resins worldwide. The company offers printing materials, including gravure, flexo, metal decoration, inkjet, security, jet, offset, printing plates, and news inks; packaging adhesives; multilayer films; and polystyrene products. It also provides color material products, such as organic pigments; pigments for display applications, coatings, plastics, printing inks, digital printing, color filters, and cosmetics; effect pigments; health food products; aluminum for autoclaved aerated concrete; natural blue colorants; ultrananno microalgae feed; microalgae feed; and algal-derived DHA oil products; and sun chemical pigments. The company offers display materials comprising thin-film transistor and nematic liquid crystals; performance materials, including coating, adhesives, UV-curable, waterborne, acrylic, polyurethane, epoxy, phenolic, polyester/alkyd, unsaturated polyester, and other resins, as well as sulphur chemicals, fiber and textile colorants, metal carboxylates, modifiers, alkylphenols, metal carboxylates, and surfactants; and synthetic resins for inks. It also provides acrylic, polyurethane, epoxy, phenolic, polyester / alkyd, and unsaturated polyester resins; butadiene resin latex; UV-curable resin for optical / coatings; modifiers; alkylphenols; metal carboxylates; sulfur chemicals; industrial adhesive tapes and hollow fiber membrane; polyphenylene sulfide and Functional Compounds; Textile Printing Agents / Leather Colorants; and masterbatch for fibers/films. In addition, the company offers DLP 3D printing materials, multi-functional exopolysaccharide, corporate venture capital, multifunctional robot finger, tactile sensitivity enhancer, and omnidirectional multicopter. The company was formerly known as Dainippon Ink and Chemicals, Incorporated and changed its name to DIC Corporation in April 2008. The company was founded in 1908 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
business_summary_ko: DIC Corporation은 전 세계적으로 인쇄 잉크, 유기안료, 합성수지를 제조 및 판매하고 있습니다. 이 회사는 그라비아, 플렉소, 금속 장식, 잉크젯, 보안, 제트, 오프셋, 인쇄판 및 뉴스 잉크를 포함한 인쇄 재료를 제공합니다. 포장 접착제; 다층 필름; 및 폴리스티렌 제품. 또한 유기안료 등의 색재제품도 제공합니다. 디스플레이 응용 분야용 안료, 코팅, 플라스틱, 인쇄 잉크, 디지털 인쇄, 컬러 필터 및 화장품; 효과 안료; 건강식품; 고압멸균된 폭기 콘크리트용 알루미늄; 천연 청색 착색제; 울트라나노 미세조류 사료; 미세조류 사료; 및 조류 유래 DHA 오일 제품; 그리고 태양 화학 안료. 이 회사는 박막 트랜지스터와 네마틱 액정으로 구성된 디스플레이 재료를 제공합니다. 코팅, 접착제, UV 경화성, 수성, 아크릴, 폴리우레탄, 에폭시, 페놀성, 폴리에스테르/알키드, 불포화 폴리에스테르 및 기타 수지뿐만 아니라 황 화학물질, 섬유 및 직물 착색제, 금속 카르복실산염, 개질제, 알킬페놀, 금속 카르복실산염 및 계면활성제를 포함한 기능성 소재; 잉크용 합성수지 등이 있다. 또한 아크릴, 폴리우레탄, 전자 제품도 제공합니다.
